messages.subject: Detection functions in polygon detectors
parts:
Using the updated detection function for polygon detectors, D for my study animal is now 4.2/100 km2. With the same parameters for the null model with detectionfn=HN earlier, density was 2.6/100 km2. So, if I had used results before the update, my density estimate would have been much smaller. But, just changing the detectionfn to HHN seems to increase D estimates. The same study would have yielded different densities.

Is this expected? Does anyone have a similar experience? I'm just wondering if I am missing something. 

Thank you.

messages.subject: Re: Detection functions in polygon detectors
parts:
Dear Tshewang
Sorry for my terseness before - I was in a hurry, holding a baby (not mine), and typing with one hand.
I would not have expected such a large difference - the examples I've tried have been much closer. However, with only 5 recaptured animals and 10 recaptures it is perhaps not surprising that the estimate is somewhat unstable. If you feel comfortable to privately send me an example dataset then I may be able to say more.
Murray
